tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published AI software listings by free text, category slug or pricing model. Returns a total plus compact summaries.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Return the full public listing for one tool by slug, including its Markdown copy, related tools and dated official verified facts when available.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every active category with its slug, description and the number of published tools in it.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two to five published tools side by side, including dated official verified facts when available. Unknown slugs are reported in missing instead of being guessed.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_tool" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return the full public listing for one tool by slug, including its Markdown copy and related tools." → after: "Return the full public listing for one tool by slug, including its Markdown copy, related tools and dated official verified facts when available."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
